description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) 'DataGroupPermissionFilterParams' used for filtering data group permissions based on roles, entities, permissions, and other criteria within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating parameters to filter data group permissions, including roles, entities, dataGroups, and flags for API data groups, accessibility, and permissions.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the list of UserRole objects associated with this filter.

methods.name: setUserRoles
methods.description: Sets the list of UserRole objects for this filter.

methods.name: isWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Checks if the filter includes API data groups.

methods.name: setWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Sets whether to include API data groups in the filter.

methods.name: isOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Returns whether the filter restricts to only accessible permissions.

methods.name: setOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Defines if the filter should consider only accessible permissions.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Retrieves list of roles to exclude from filtering.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to exclude from filtering.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Retrieves list of roles to include in filtering.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to include in filtering.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Gets the list of entity identifiers for filtering.

methods.name: setEntities
methods.description: Sets the list of entity identifiers for filtering.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Retrieves list of data groups to filter.

methods.name: setDataGroups
methods.description: Sets the list of data groups for filtering.

methods.name: isSelfPermissions
methods.description: Checks whether the filtering is based on self permissions.

methods.name: setSelfPermissions
methods.description: Sets whether the filtering should consider self permissions.
